freeze.rationale: decode_segments8 already captures in-graph short kernels, so avoided launches on the parent are zero for those chains. Causal upper bound is remaining intermediate traffic at 100 GB/s plus the single out-of-graph embed cast. OPT-119 norm→Q8 is reused, not recreated. GDN chains stay unfrozen because OPT-109 isolated win / enclosing loss. Last residual→logits_norm crosses the last segment cancellation poll. Candidates freeze only when the bound clears 0.2000 ms/token (max of 0.2 ms and 1% of parent graph wall). 2% request materiality is 0.3274 ms/token. A kernel-only speedup is not a keep.
